# A variable set to nothing is not an override. A shell exports empty strings
# for variables nobody set, and a rung that took them would silently unconfigure
# every machine that has one.
user {"store":"A"}
# expect 1: ok
env store empty
# expect 2: ok
load
# expect 3: ok store=A/user [CFG-E1]
key store
# expect 4: ok value=A from=user [CFG-E1]
